values.repository_observation: HealthModifier x gt_npc_total_hp_exp3 equals the Wowhead NPC pages exactly (Nefarian 265 x 85892, Onyxia 65 x 85892, Prototype 21 x 77490 at level 85).
values.source_truth: Wowhead guide reports about 1.25x for Onyxia and Nefarian normal and 6.9M prototypes; no WCL-derived max HP yet.
values.implementation_consequence: No health change; derive max HP from a matched WCL kill with derive_encounter_health.

values.repository_observation: Every creature has DamageModifier 1 since sql/updates/world/4.3.4/2025_06_18_06_world.sql; Nefarian/Onyxia class 1 level 88 BaseAttackTime 1500, bone warrior class 4 level 85 BaseAttackTime 2000 BaseVariance 0.5. Old TDB DamageModifier was 90 (10N) and 6 (warrior) under the previous formula.
values.implementation_consequence: Calibrate from WCL U samples (after_attacker_bonus_amount) before any staged DamageModifier.

values.unit: yards centre to centre vs a player
values.repository_observation: creature_model_info CombatReach 20/18/4.375/3.75 plus player reach 1.5 and the 4/3 allowance (Unit::GetMeleeRange).
values.implementation_consequence: A dragon only turns while its tank stays inside its reach; leading it requires leaving the reach.

values.source_truth: 1 s cast, 0.5 s ticks for 1.5 s (3 ticks, 105k in 10N per Wowhead), 60-degree cone, 60 yd; refills bone warriors in the cone.
values.repository_observation: SpellMgr sets the aura period to 1500 (one tick); no DBC cone angle, so the 90-degree default applies.
values.implementation_consequence: Bots treat the wider native 90-degree cone as the hazard; the tick count is a WCL question (breath_ticks view).

values.source_truth: instant, ConeDegrees -82 (82-degree rear cone), 60 yd; Journal text says 60 degrees
values.implementation_consequence: Raid positions avoid the rear 82 degrees of each dragon.

values.source_truth: 5 s wind-up aura 78090, then 77832 pulses every 1 s for 5 s; Journal: from the orbs along her sides; Wowhead: tank turns her 90 degrees when the wings glow.
values.repository_observation: spell_custom_attr gives 77833 CONE_BACK (90 degrees) and 77836 is a front cone (90 native, 60 in 4.4.2); both grant immunity and 77943 hits everyone else within 60 yd, i.e. the flanks.
values.implementation_consequence: Onyxia tank steps outward on the wind-up so her tail faces the raid (TankStep::Discharge).

values.source_truth: every 10% of Nefarian's health, 5 s after the raid emote (both addons)
values.repository_observation: DamageTaken schedules EVENT_ELECTROCUTE 5 s after each threshold
values.implementation_consequence: Phase 1 damage budget; healers top off.

values.implementation_consequence: One 10-second interrupter per pillar suffices at the native 13 s repeat; the backup acts after 1.8 s of the 4 s cast or when the primary is gone.

values.source_truth: 2 s cast; Wowhead: 10 players every 3 s
values.repository_observation: SpellMgr caps targets at 4 (10-player) / 8 (25-player); repeat 2.5 s

values.source_truth: client 78949 period 1 s, 95793 period 2 s; guides +25 per Electrocute, Wowhead +1 per 2 s
values.repository_observation: SpellMgr raises Onyxia's period to 3 s; Electrocute adds 17
values.implementation_consequence: Bot budget reads the live alternate power, not a timer.

values.unit: bone warriors (24 s aura / tick period)

values.source_truth: Wowhead: 2% per second, collapse after 50 s

values.implementation_consequence: Shackle Undead, Hammer of Justice, Frost Nova, Concussive Shot, Frost Shock, Chains of Ice, Curse of Exhaustion.

values.unit: shadowflame per 1 s tick within 4 yd

values.implementation_consequence: Stay 8 yd from any fire; keep the raid away from warrior piles.

lifecycle.repository: Spawn group 402 (Nefarius, orb, two stalkers) spawns only when Magmaw, Omnotron, Chimaeron, Atramedes and Maloriak are done; the shard seeds that lockout as diagnostic assistance.
Orb gossip -> intro -> Onyxia reanimated at Nefarian's lift-off -> Onyxia Start Fight 2 pulls only players on the elevator transport; Onyxia JustEngagedWith sets IN_PROGRESS.
Evade -> FAIL, elevator raised (or raised after the remaining lowering time), summons despawned, spawn group 402 despawned, Nefarian respawns after 30 s without the intro.
Boss states persist; the intro-done flag is not written by WriteSaveDataMore, so a reload before the kill would need the orb again.

Nefarian 41376/51104-51106, Onyxia 41270/51116-51118 and Animated Bone Warrior 41918 run at DamageModifier 1; no matched U samples.
Native equals Wowhead NPC pages; Wowhead guide is about 1.25x for Onyxia/Nefarian normal and 6.9M prototypes.
Nefarian phase 1 Tail Lash every 5 s natively vs 10-20 s sources; breath one tick natively vs three; cones 90 natively vs 60 in 4.4.2.

Native Blast Nova 3.5 s then 13 s vs Wowhead 8 s; Barrage 4 targets every 2.5 s vs Wowhead 10 every 3 s.

Players swim up through the magma (Wowhead; the lip can block jumping); package T cannot swim or climb, so no lawful pillar ascent exists yet. Lava navmesh at z 3.0 and pillar tops at 3.06 lowered suggest the tops sit just above the magma; the exact surface height is unobserved.
